name: Joanna (wife of Chuza)
title: Faithful Female Disciple
summary: Joanna was married to Chuza, a steward of Herod Antipas. She was one of the women who followed Jesus and supported him and his disciples with their own resources. She was also among the first witnesses of Jesus' resurrection.

keyEvents.title: Healed by Jesus
keyEvents.description: Joanna was one of several women who had been healed of evil spirits and diseases by Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Supported Jesus with her resources
keyEvents.description: Together with other women, Joanna used her own resources to support Jesus and the twelve disciples during their ministry.

keyEvents.title: At the Empty Tomb
keyEvents.description: Joanna was among the women who went to the tomb on Easter morning with fragrant oils and found it empty.

keyEvents.title: Meeting the Angels
keyEvents.description: At the tomb, Joanna and the other women met two angels who proclaimed Jesus' resurrection to them.

keyEvents.title: Proclaimed the Resurrection to the Apostles
keyEvents.description: Joanna helped bring the message of Jesus' resurrection to the eleven apostles, even though they initially did not believe the women's testimony.
